subject: Schema governance & runtime checkpoints for structured streaming outputs
messages:
From: Samira Shah <samira@clairhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Schema governance & runtime checkpoints for structured streaming outputs

Hi Avery / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Clair is keen to move from pilot to a phased enablement, but we want to lock down the JSON schema and runtime acceptance criteria before the first wave. Attached is our initial schema (claire_schema_v1.json) and a scoping sheet that maps user journeys to required structured fields.

Top asks from our side:
- Confirm a validation gate for structured outputs (schema + enum checks).
- Define runtime SLOs for streaming responses (max initial latency, tail latency targets).
- Clarify function/tool-calling contract (how we pass tool metadata back to the caller).
- A lightweight test harness we can run against staging (synthetic sessions).

Can we schedule a working session next week to align on the governance checklist and a short rollout runway? Ideally include Solutions Eng and whoever will own the snapshots/telemetry for JSON regressions.

Attachments: [Attachment: claire_schema_v1.json (application/json)], [Attachment: scoping-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks,
Samira
Product Lead — Clair Health


From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Samira Shah <samira@clairhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Schema governance & runtime checkpoints for structured streaming outputs

Hi Samira — appreciate the materials. I reviewed the schema briefly and shared it with Karthik and Monica. High level plan proposal:

1) Governance gate (schema verification):
   - We will run schema validation as a preflight check in staging using your supplied JSON schema; mismatches will be tracked as blocking issues for the rollout bundle.
   - Add a regression test set (10 representative prompts) that must pass.

2) Runtime checkpoints:
   - Initial latency SLO: 95th perc initial token <= 350ms (staging baseline), tail (99th) <= 800ms.
   - Streaming session window: up to 60s active streaming per request, with idle cutoff at 5s for session close.

3) Function/tool calling:
   - Karthik will provide a sample tool-calling contract (JSON snippet) we expect to return in the streaming envelope so you can validate end-to-end.

4) Test harness + telemetry:
   - Neha will own the onboarding harness; we’ll deliver a small runner you can execute against our staging tenant. It will produce token-level latency, schema compliance rates, and per-route error traces.

Proposed working session: Tue 2028-08-08 10:00am PT (30–45m). Please confirm or suggest an alternate. I attached a short outline to steer the conversation.

Attachments: [Attachment: enablement-outline.md (text/markdown)]

Thanks — Avery
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Tue 8/8 10am PT works for us. A couple of quick clarifications ahead of the call:

- We have a small requirement around tool calling: when the assistant invokes an external triage tool, the streaming envelope should include both the tool id and the resolved arguments (scrubbed) so our audit logs can correlate actions. Is that something Redwood's streaming envelope already supports?

- On schema flexibility: we expect optional extension fields (prefixed with _cl), but enums for status and clinical_code must be enforced. Would like the test harness to report per-field fail rates so we can see drift over time.

Will invite our tech lead Rajiv to the call.

Samira

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Shah <samira@clairhealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Aug 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Schema governance & runtime checkpoints for structured streaming outputs

Hi all — quick technical notes following the call (summarizing for the record):

- Streaming envelope: we include per-event metadata and can add a tool_call object when a tool is invoked. Proposed snippet in the envelope: {"tool_call": {"tool_id": "triage_v1", "args": {"symptom_code": "123"}, "resolved_at": "2028-08-08T17:44:00Z"}}
  - We will mark the args field as optionally redacted; staging mode will include full args (for validation), prod mode will include scrubbed args.

- Session/kv cache: for streaming sessions with function calls we keep a per-session KV window of 32 entries (LRU); please flag any session-level state you need persisted between requests.

- Token limits and chunking: recommend chunked streaming for outputs over 2k tokens; the harness will report per-chunk latencies alongside token-level percentiles.

- Tool-calling examples attached (toolcall_examples.txt) with three variants: sync, async-with-callback, and callback-with-local-cache.

Next steps: I’ll upload the example contract to the shared drive and open a small RFC for the tool_call envelope fields so we have a source of truth.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: [Attachment: toolcall_examples.txt (text/plain)]

Thanks everyone — great sync today. Quick summary and next steps so we have alignment: 

1) Documentation & artifact delivery (target 2028-08-11):
   - Karthik will publish the tool_call envelope contract to the shared Drive and open an RFC.
   - I’ll drop the enabled regression set and the enablement checklist into your shared Drive folder.

2) Test harness & staging (target 2028-08-18):
   - Neha’s team will hand over the harness runner and instructions for executing against the Clair staging tenant. The runner will output a per-field compliance CSV and token-latency percentiles.

3) Acceptance criteria before wave 1:
   - Schema pass rate >= 98% on the regression set; no critical enum mismatches.
   - 95th perc initial token <= 350ms in staging; production SLOs to be agreed during Pilot review.

4) Action owners:
   - Karthik: tool_call contract + upload (RFC id will be posted).
   - Neha: harness delivery and runbook.
   - Monica: CS acceptance and roll plan coordination.
   - Avery: overall enablement lead and weekly check-ins.

I created a quick invite and added the HubSpot deal note. Please confirm availability for a 15-minute sync next Friday for a final pre-flight check (2028-08-18 9:00am PT).

Links: https://hubspot.com/deals/CLH-2028-045 | Drive: https://drive.re/redwood/claire-onboard/schema-v1 | Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=avery-claire-kickoff

Cheers,
Avery
